panels.title: How to read this — and what to do about it

options.content:
**Read top-down. Stop at the first stage that is red — that is your binding constraint. Everything below it is a symptom, not a cause.**

| # | Stage | Red when | What it means | Do this |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **SUPPLY** | `Clean live labels` flat or < 30 | The loop is starved. No amount of model work matters — there is nothing to learn from. | Check `Live labels` beside it: if live is climbing and clean is not, hygiene is eating the rows, so read `Label uniqueness`. If both are flat, the bot is not closing trades. |
| 2 | **CORPUS** | `Era exclusion` ACTIVE with `New-era rows` < 150, or uniqueness < 0.05 | You have rows but they do not count. Overlapping horizons mean N labels carry far less than N labels of evidence (AFML ch. 4 — sample weights redistribute so overlap cannot double-count). | Wait for new-era rows to reach 150, or shorten the label horizon. A corpus of 274 rows at uniqueness 0.05 is an effective sample near 14. |
| 3 | **QUALITY** | `Brier` at or above baseline, or `Calibration gap` widening | The model is not beating the base rate, or its probabilities are not the thing they claim to be. Kelly reads probabilities literally, so a calibration error is a *sizing* error. | Compare against `champion` on the Brier chart. If live is worse than baseline, the honest move is to stand the model down, not retune it. |
| 4 | **GOVERNOR** | `Model in use` NO while 1–3 are green | The model earned its place and is still muted. | This is usually correct — a stand-down, not a fault. Check the governor level on VITALS before overriding anything. |

**When all four are green and it still loses money**, the constraint is not learning — it is geometry. A selector cannot harvest an edge smaller than costs: check cost per round trip against horizon sigma (`scripts/horizon_bootstrap.py`) and the gate's realized separation (`scripts/gate_efficacy_report.py`). At a 2-hour horizon this bot paid 0.82 sigma per round trip and no selector could win; the fix was the horizon, not the model.

*Sample-size discipline throughout: prefer `Win rate LCB` (Wilson lower bound) to the point estimate, and treat any conclusion drawn from fewer than ~30 clean live labels as a hypothesis rather than a finding.*

options.content:
**THALES** is the bot's footprint & manipulation-defense layer — evidence-weighted detectors that shade sizing when a book looks *engineered* rather than organic. Every score is **0–1** (higher = more suspicious) and **reliability-weighted**: a detector only bites once it has proven itself on realized outcomes (Wilson-LCB), so it can't cry wolf.

- **grid / metronome / clockwork** — periodicity footprints: grid-bot ladders, fixed-interval refills, time-of-day algo seasonality.
- **stop-zone** — proximity to round-number stop clusters (stop-hunt zones).
- **bar-close** — order-flow clustering at bar closes.
- **spoof bid / ask** — flicker: large levels that appear then vanish without the mid ever crossing (**TH-017**).
- **feed dirty / lapses / bar holes** — feed integrity; a dirty feed is quarantined, never traded.

THALES **never triggers a trade** — it only *attenuates*: shade the size, or down-weight that row in learning (a painted book teaches the painter's lesson, not the market's).

panels.title: THALES detector scorecard (higher = more suspicious)
panels.description: Per-asset footprint scores (0-1) + feed-integrity counters. THALES only ATTENUATES (shade size / down-weight the training row) — it never triggers a trade.

panels.title: Spoof-flicker pressure (bid)
panels.description: TH-017 spoof EWMA per asset — higher = a book being painted; THALES shades size there. Wall-time normalized 2026-07-29: the score no longer depends on poll cadence, only on the spoofer's actual flip rate.

panels.title: Stop-hunt zone proximity
panels.description: Proximity to round-number stop clusters per asset. 2026-07-29 recalibration: the geometric base rate (tolerance band / magnet spacing) is now subtracted, so a random mark reads ~0 — before this the gauge sat at 0.4-0.5 everywhere the price grid was fine (43% of history >0.5 with zero PnL discrimination). A high reading now means the mark is genuinely AT a magnet.

panels.title: Manipulation suspicion
panels.description: Parameter-free max of the manipulation footprints per asset.

panels.title: Detector reliability — lift over base rate (earning its keep)
panels.description: THALES V2 vindication ledger (2026-07-29 unlock): every closed model-lane trade grades the detectors that advised on its entry — in SHADOW mode too, so this is the promotion-to-advise evidence accruing live. Weight = the detector's Wilson-LCB win/loss lift over the base rate below (0 = no proven edge over just knowing the base rate; the shade gain scales by it in advise mode). Empty table = ledger still accruing its first min_fired=20 grades per detector.

panels.title: Graded closes
panels.description: Closed trades graded into the THALES reliability ledger (the __base__ null's sample size). Started counting 2026-07-29 — was structurally stuck at 0 before (grading was advise-gated while promotion required shadow evidence).

panels.title: Base win rate
panels.description: Win rate across ALL graded closes — the null each detector must BEAT to earn shade weight ('up' advice vs this, 'down' advice vs its complement). The 2026-07-29 correction replaced the old 0.5 coin-flip null that muted honest detectors on a ~16%-win stream.

panels.title: Label supply — is training data arriving?
panels.description: The three label pools over time. live_clean gates retraining; it was pinned at 0 for thirteen days and no tile could show that. FLAT is the alarm here, not the all-clear.

panels.title: Era exclusion — progress toward re-arming
panels.description: New-era rows against the min_rows threshold that arms era-gated training. Both are plotted so the GAP is the visible quantity — distance to the threshold is what you actually want to read, and two separate tiles make you subtract by hand.

panels.title: Calibration quality — is the model honest?
panels.description: A gap that WIDENS while labels accumulate means the model is learning the wrong thing — the one failure mode that looks identical to healthy progress on a state tile.

panels.title: Admission funnel — is the gate passing anything?
panels.description: A gate whose admitted line rides at zero while evaluated climbs is selecting against itself — which is what scripts/gate_efficacy_report.py measured at -12.2% separation. The divergence is the signal; neither line alone shows it.
